lessons_learned: Lesson 1: On BTC/USD (5m), local swing low of 76952 was swept down to 76852 by institutional liquidity grab before continuation. Tight 1.8 ATR Stop Loss was hunted by a single wick.
Optimization 1: Elevated Base Stop Loss from 1.8 ATR to 2.5 ATR and increased structural hunt buffer from 0.20 ATR to 0.45 ATR.
Optimization 2: Tightened Scalp TP1 multiplier to 0.38 ATR for faster 90-95% target fulfillment and earlier risk-free Breakeven lock-in.
Status: XAU/USD 1m setup was fully aligned (5/5 Pillars) and shorted at 4338.197 with TP1 at 4335.587.
